compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem
This 15-path tests/scripts cohort has 49 editable prose blocks. The current immutable implementation basis is merged origin/main@10a91af197f9b1016382f08d4f77b4e477c386be. Three prior targets (CLI, LLM, and MCP-server seam-clean tests) were deleted upstream and are excluded. Other surviving paths include intervening executable changes; comparing against the current basis preserves those changes. The group07 commit combines this leaf with linguistic-dental-eyra.

## Approach
Edit only ordinary comments/docstrings at these stable module, symbol, or prose-first-line anchors. Do not edit code, assertions, directives, runtime strings, _stub(...) payloads, or unlisted prose.

For each Python path, parse base/final text with ast.parse(source, type_comments=True); recursively remove only the leading Expr(Constant(str)) from Module, ClassDef, FunctionDef, and AsyncFunctionDef bodies; normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; and require exact ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False) equality. Separately compare directives because comments are absent from the AST.

A non-author reviewer posts exactly 49 TSV rows:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session
Citations use full immutable before/final SHAs. Both verdicts must be PASS; missing rows block closure.

## Scope — 49 blocks
- test_check_config_reads_red_proof.py — module; scoped old_gate prose; test_the_pre_fix_gate_silently_passes_the_inert_field and test_a_uniquely_named_inert_field_fired_on_BOTH_versions docstrings. Preserve the live/prefixed differential and unique-name control.
- test_check_config_reads.py — module and test_same_named_field_on_an_unrelated_config_does_not_satisfy_it docstrings. Preserve owner resolution, markers, and name collision.
- test_check_import_walk.py — module and test_sibling_insert_cannot_mask_the_missing_one docstrings. Preserve fresh-process isolation and import coverage.
- test_check_orphaned_load.py — module and scoped prose after test_real_adapter_reads_live_process_table_without_raising. Preserve read-only PID-1/high-CPU detection and daemon exclusion.
- test_dependency_audit.py — module; scoped prose around test_gate_gerrit_fails_closed_when_the_diff_is_unresolvable, test_a_real_finding_is_not_retried, and test_advisory_alert_close_argv_survives_the_real_transition_parser; comment beginning "A missing audit verdict is NOT an all-clear…"; and docstrings of test_only_an_explicit_false_verdict_may_close_the_advisory_ticket, test_a_missing_verdict_writes_nothing_at_all, test_a_crashed_audit_is_distinguishable_from_a_genuine_all_clear, and test_a_missing_verdict_is_still_silent_under_dry_run. Preserve routing, retry, real-parser, tri-state BLOCKING, and no-write-on-missing-verdict contracts.
- test_mcp_client_pats.py — module docstring; preserve per-client separation, materialization, fail-closed behavior, and nondisclosure.
- test_mutation_sandbox.py — module; scoped prose in test_a_mechanism_is_required_when_the_lane_says_so, test_the_incident_shape_rm_rf_is_denied, and test_seatbelt_present_but_not_enforcing_is_not_offered; comment before test_ambient_ci_does_not_waive_the_sandbox; test_the_sandboxed_subprocesses_receive_the_hardened_env docstring; comment before _is_mutmut_run. Preserve containment, child-liveness, capability probes, hardened env, and whole-module binding.
- test_normalize_ci_conclusion.py — module docstring; preserve two-input normalization/closed output.
- test_observability_coldstart_e2a6.py — module; _environment cursor comment; _state docstring; seed comment in test_cold_start_publishes_zero_and_seeds_the_offset. Preserve publish-before-persist, cursor state, and the bare-total log exception.
- test_observability_data_disk_debris.py — module docstring; preserve non-site census, real du, bounded dimensions, and no fabricated zero.
- test_observability_disk_pressure.py — module; _environment cursor comment; _state_total, test_disk_pressure_markers_are_counted_into_their_own_metric, and test_no_persistence_markers_publishes_zero docstrings. Preserve record anchoring, ineffective-reclaim persistence, and separate scratch-mount signal.
- test_observability_exit.py — module docstring; preserve aggregate exit-zero with visible individual failures.
- test_observability_marker_anchor_8c2f.py — module; _environment cursor comment; test_offsets_inflated_by_false_counts_cannot_distort_a_delta docstring and inline inflated-total comment. Preserve cursor immunity to inflated legacy totals, not obsolete "lost-history clamp" wording.
- test_observability_mcp_health_9ea3.py — module plus test_an_unhealthy_serving_path_publishes_zero_not_nothing and test_upstream_lost_mid_gate_latches_a_sustained_zero docstrings. Preserve 401-as-healthy, explicit bad-path zero, and serving-path independence.
- test_observability_mcp_markers.py — module; _environment cursor comment; cold-start seed comment in test_cold_start_seeds_offsets_and_publishes_zero. Preserve separate retire-cap/memory-abort counters.

The 14 additions are dependency_audit +5, coldstart_e2a6 +3, disk_pressure +2, marker_anchor_8c2f +2, and mcp_markers +2.

## Consumers / exclusions
Pytest consumes all 15 modules; scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py consumes prose deterministically. No targeted __doc__, inspect.getdoc, or doctest consumer was found.

Observability tests import tests/scripts/_journald_stub.py, but it is outside the parent's retired boundary and must not enter file impact. Its JOURNALCTL_EMULATOR/TIMEOUT_STUB and every scoped _stub(...) multiline string are runtime content. No directives exist in the 15 paths; the directive signature must stay empty.

- [ ] Only the 49 anchors or adjacent blank lines change, and every edited block is shorter/current.
- [ ] Normalized ASTs exactly match 10a91af197f9b1016382f08d4f77b4e477c386be; runtime payloads remain identical.
- [ ] The directive signature remains empty.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the union of both leaves' 22 file-impact paths and excludes _journald_stub.py.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has exactly 49 PASS/PASS rows with full SHAs.
- [ ] All seven structured semantic, directive, path, diff, hygiene, focused-test, and make-verify checks pass.

## Verification
Run every structured verify command. Automated guards prove structure; the independent TSV is authoritative for prose quality. The focused command executes all scoped files, including the new dependency-audit nodes and renamed marker test.
